references_used.why: Structural source for the owl template — section order and component shapes only. No Owl brand assets, program names, or copy carried over.
MLA canonical roofing reference for tone and fixed section discipline.

brand_source: Client's own logo mark, sampled pixel-wise (navy #053173, red #b60c16), cross-checked against the live CSS custom properties read from computed styles on https://www.gtroofinghomeimprovements.com/ (--primary hsl(210 100% 20%) = #003366, --accent hsl(0 100% 40%) = #cc0000, --foreground hsl(0 0% 20%), --radius .5rem, font-family DM Sans). The logo values win — the mark is what actually sits next to these colours on every page. Brand tokens only; no layout, component, or class data extracted.

contrast_audit.white_on_accent: 6.88:1 — AA pass. --color-on-accent is #ffffff, measured not assumed.
contrast_audit.accent_ink_on_bg: 6.36:1 — AA pass. Brand red is dark enough to serve as foreground text on light surfaces unchanged, so accent_ink equals accent.
contrast_audit.accent_on_dark_over_primary: 4.97:1 — AA pass. Raw #b60c16 on navy measures only 1.80:1 and fails, so the dark bands (Testimonials, ProcessSteps, WhyChooseUs, hero scrim) use the #ff7d70 tint of the same brand red. The owl template does not ship this token — the four components were patched in this client site only, never upstream.

typography.source: Client's own Google Fonts link — DM Sans wght 400;500;600;700;800. Used for both roles; the 800 weight carries the display role.

radius.source: Client --radius is .5rem (8px); md matches exactly, sm/lg are the template's proportional steps.

anti_patterns: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
Owl Roofing brand program names ("We Give A Hoot", "Protect Your Nest System", "Get It Right Guarantee") — Owl brand assets, never reused
any "Licensed, Bonded & Insured" badge — G&T has published no such claim and no PA HIC number is on public record
